A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before you
say hello.

Where do you cover events?+

Listed service areas include Salem, Erode, Coimbatore and Pan India. Share your venue to discuss availability and travel arrangements.

How do I check my event date?+

Prepare an enquiry with your date, event type and venue. Ask the studio to confirm availability; an enquiry does not reserve a date.

Can I ask for photography and films?+

Select “Photography & films” in the enquiry page to include both requirements.

How much does coverage cost?+

Share your event date, venue and coverage requirements to request a quote. Confirm the price, deliverables and payment terms with the studio before booking.
